title: SysML v2 是什么
summary: 先建立 SysML v2 的汽车工程全景，再用一个连续演进的电动汽车模型练习 package、part def、part、需求追踪和分析入口。

thumbnail.alt: Course 01 汽车工程全景与 SysML v2 模型边界缩略图

objectives: 理解 SysML v2 把工程事实放入可校验文本模型，而不是只画图或写说明文档
识别本课程会反复使用的结构、接口、行为、状态、需求、分析和验证建模维度
能从空白 package 逐步补全电动汽车结构、系统边界和第一条需求追踪线
理解 def 定义类型、usage 放入具体模型上下文的基本模式

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A Package is a Namespace used to group Elements, without any instance-level semantics. It may have one or more model-level evaluable filterCondition Expressions used to filter its importedMemberships. Any imported member must meet all of the filterConditions.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: Package 是一种 Namespace，用来组织模型元素，本身不表达实例级语义。
conceptExplanations.explanation: Package 是可校验模型的工程边界。汽车项目里，需求、结构、接口、分析和验证都应放入明确命名空间，避免模型元素散落在全局空间。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: package EV_C01_L01 { part def ElectricVehicle; } 用一个包承载课程中的车辆模型边界。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A Namespace is an Element that contains other Elements, known as its members, via Membership Relationships with those Elements. The members of a Namespace may be owned by the Namespace, aliased in the Namespace, or imported into the Namespace via Import Relationships.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: Namespace 是包含其他元素的 Element，这些元素通过 Membership 关系成为它的成员。
conceptExplanations.explanation: Namespace 决定名称解析和模型边界。同名 BatteryPack 如果出现在不同包里，需要通过包边界和限定名区分。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: 把 BatteryPack 放在 EV_Structure 包内，需求或分析包可以通过导入或限定名引用它。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A PartDefinition is an ItemDefinition of a Class of systems or parts of systems. Note that all parts may be considered items for certain purposes, but not all items are parts that can perform actions within a system.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: PartDefinition 是系统或系统部件类别的 ItemDefinition。
conceptExplanations.explanation: part def 定义可复用的物理产品或系统类型。它类似工程图纸或产品平台定义，不表示某一台具体样车。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: part def ElectricVehicle { part battery : BatteryPack; } 定义电动汽车结构模板。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A PartUsage is a usage of a PartDefinition to represent a system or a part of a system. At least one of the itemDefinitions of the PartUsage must be a PartDefinition.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: PartUsage 是 PartDefinition 的一次使用，用来表示一个系统或系统部件。
conceptExplanations.explanation: part 把定义放入具体模型上下文。课程中的 battery : BatteryPack 是 ElectricVehicle 结构里出现的一份电池包使用。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: part evPrototype : ElectricVehicle; 表示一个可用于需求追踪和分析讨论的样车模型对象。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A RequirementDefinition is a ConstraintDefinition that defines a requirement used in the context of a specification as a constraint that a valid solution must satisfy. The specification is relative to a specified subject, possibly in collaboration with one or more external actors.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: RequirementDefinition 是一种 ConstraintDefinition，用来定义有效解决方案必须满足的需求。
conceptExplanations.explanation: requirement def 定义需求类型。它让需求不是散落在文档里的句子，而是可命名、可追踪、可被验证的模型对象类型。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: requirement def VehicleNeed; 定义车辆能力需求模板，例如可用续航、安全阈值或充电目标。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A RequirementUsage is a Usage of a RequirementDefinition.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: RequirementUsage 是 RequirementDefinition 的一次使用。
conceptExplanations.explanation: requirement 表示具体工程需求。Course 1 只建立最小追踪线，后续需求课程再展开文本、约束和验证目标。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: requirement usableRange : VehicleNeed; 表示当前车型要满足的城市续航可用性需求。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: An AnalysisCaseDefinition is a CaseDefinition for the case of carrying out an analysis.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: AnalysisCaseDefinition 是用于执行分析的 CaseDefinition。
conceptExplanations.explanation: analysis def 定义分析案例类型，用来组织为什么分析、分析什么对象、后续如何连接计算或验证。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: analysis def VehicleModelPurpose; 表示用于评估车辆模型是否足以回答续航需求的分析入口。

conceptExplanations.source: OMG SysML v2.0 Language Specification / SysML.ecore
conceptExplanations.standardEnglish: A SatisfyRequirementUsage is an AssertConstraintUsage that asserts, by default, that a satisfied RequirementUsage is true for a specific satisfyingFeature, or, if isNegated = true, that the RequirementUsage is false. The satisfied RequirementUsage is related to the SatisfyRequirementUsage by a ReferenceSubsetting Relationship.
conceptExplanations.chineseTranslation: SatisfyRequirementUsage 断言某个特定模型特征满足一个 RequirementUsage。
conceptExplanations.explanation: satisfy 建立需求到结构或行为的责任链。它不是注释，而是模型中的可追踪关系。
conceptExplanations.engineeringExample: satisfy usableRange by evPrototype; 表示样车模型对象承担满足续航需求的责任。
